title: Barua ya Kirafiki (Theme 4: Dira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the parts of a friendly letter in order on the page: address and date on the right, greeting, body, closing and name.
representations: a model letter with the parts labelled
part cards to order on a blank page
steps: Write the address and date at the top right.
Write the greeting on the left.
contexts: a pen pal in another county

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child orders the part cards on a blank page.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa anwani ya mwandishi, kisha tarehe, kisha ___." Kwa nini "hitimisho" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki ina anwani ya mwandishi, tarehe, salamu, mwili, hitimisho na jina.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Hitimisho la barua ya kirafiki ni "___ "." Kwa nini "Wako mtiifu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa "Mpendwa..." na kuisha kwa "Rafiki yako". "Wako mtiifu" ni ya barua rasmi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Anwani ya mwandishi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu." Kwa nini "kushoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Anwani ya mwandishi huandikwa upande wa kulia juu, kisha tarehe chini yake.

misconceptions.ask: Rafiki atajuaje barua imetoka kwa nani?
misconceptions.repair: Malizia barua kwa hitimisho na jina lako.

checks.question: Ni salamu ipi ya barua ya kirafiki?

skills.key_step: The child plans barua ya kirafiki before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Mwelekeo wa Nyumbani Kwetu".

misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.

misconceptions.ask: Rafiki yako anakuita kwa jina gani?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika barua ya kirafiki kuhusu "Mwelekeo wa Nyumbani Kwetu"?
Barua ya kirafiki ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: anwani au kichwa, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho
